snippet.title: Fatherhood Legacy - Official Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Fatherhood Legacy, a VR narrative-driven adventure exploration platformer developed by VRX Immersive Studios. Players will progress through an array of different settings to repair the bond of a father and son and break generational cycles. Fatherhood Legacy is launching in January 2026 for Meta Quest.
